title: A golden horse gallops into the New Year.
description: A Lunar New Year 2026 collection built around a gilded horse from the museum's bronze collection. A desk ornament, lacquer packaging and embroidered red envelopes were sold in limited runs across Greater China.
takeaway: It turned a heritage motif into objects people display, not discard. The ornament stayed on desks long after the holiday, keeping the brand in view for months.
